product_metadata.title: New Pacific Direct Guinevere Wing Arm Accent Chairs, Café Mocha Brown/Burlap
features: CLASSIC VICTORIAN FARMHOUSE STYLE – Wingback silhouetted accent chair featuring high back, plush seat in duo-tone mocha upholstery contrasted with burlap for a charming reproduction of an English or French countryside furnishing. Removable lumbar pillow is included.
Well constructed of solid Beech wood for sturdiness, and 30% Linen, 30% Rayon, 40% Cotton upholstery fabric. Brushed Smoke leg color.
Available in other color options in Light Sand fabric and Burlap or in Nubuck Charcoal faux leather/Burlap and Nubuck Chocolate/Burlap.
Dimensions: 30.00"w   32.50"d   41.00"h. Seat Height: 19"h. Maximum bearing weight: 250 lbs.
